Subject: Novisearch QMon staging + canary checklist

Hi Rahul / Sara,

Thanks for the kickoff today — good discussion. Attached is the first-pass prompt set export (novisearch-qmon-promptset-v1.csv) and a working canary matrix that maps traffic slices to test cases (canary-matrix.xlsx).

Key asks from our side to get staging hooked into Redwood QMon:
- Confirm the staging API endpoint + auth token we should use for eval harness pulls.
- Share any high-risk prompt categories or examples you want us to prioritize in the first canary run.
- Identify 1-2 technical contacts who can approve a rollback during the canary window.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Week A: Eval harness integration and prompt ingestion.
- Week B: Dry-run canary (0% -> 5% traffic) with perf/regression smoke tests.
- Week C: Ramp to 20% and evaluate alerts; rollback test if needed.

I've CC'd Dylan and Laura to align on the canary/rollback playbook and staging instrumentation. We'll also drop a short integration guide (qmon-eval-harness-integration.md) into the shared drive after this thread.

Next step: Rahul, can you reply with the staging endpoint + token and your preferred rollback approver by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks,

--

Subject: Re: Novisearch QMon staging + canary checklist (internal alignment)

Marissa / Laura / Soojin — quick internal alignment before we reply to Novisearch.

Notes from engineering perspective:
- Eval harness: We'll add a per-request token delta tracer so the QMon eval harness can compare tokenization differences between staging and the production model path. That will help detect the issue Rahul mentioned.
- Canary matrix: we'll instrument two escalation gates — regressions on promptsets marked "high-risk" should immediately halt ramp and trigger the rollback play. Lower-severity regressions will trigger paging with longer windows. See attached canary-matrix.xlsx for gate thresholds.
- Rollback approvers: we need at least one internal owner assigned that can flip traffic quickly. Laura, can you own the operation for Novisearch during weeks B and C? We'll document the phone/SMS escalation channel.

Soojin will prepare the eval-harness integration doc and include sample curl commands and the token exchange flow. I will prepare the short rollback runbook with an automated traffic cut command and a manual approval step.

Dylan
